line.comment: * SCRIPT NAME: Mayhem.ReformTerraformer.xml
* DESCRIPTION: Reforms Xenon or OCV ships into balanced fleets.
* Restocks carriers before partitioning independent ships.
* Prevents concurrent reformations of the same race in a sector.
* @param:
* $sector: the sector where to start reforming.
* $invader: reform to either invader (TRUE) or defender fleets (FALSE).
* $race: either Xenon or OCV.
* $excludeShip: the ship to be excluded, used if called by !ship.signal.killed.
* AUTHOR: DATE: 11 September 2026
* Valid races are Xenon and OCV.
* Serializes reformations of the same race in a sector and retries queued requests.
* === Step 1: Gather eligible Terraformer ships. ===
* Excluded ship is normally a ship that's about to die.
* Ship must still be alive.
* Xenon may repurpose invaders into defenders and vice versa.
* Existing portal invaders can be reformed into another invasion,
* but must not be absorbed into a defender group.
* Check if there are any ships.
* Check whether an OCV invasion is strong enough to continue.
* An understrength OCV invasion without an M7/M1/M2 anchor retreats if the portal still exists.
* === Step 2: Restock carriers. ===
* Ships assigned as carrier support are removed from the returned array.
* It is possible for every independent non-carrier ship to be absorbed into carrier support,
* but carriers themselves remain in this array.
* === Step 3: Separate M1/M2 capitals from other independent ships. ===
* Ship may have been destroyed during carrier reorganization.
* Check if there are any ships.
* === Step 4: Determine the minimum number of groups required. ===
* Maximum of 4 M1/M2 capitals per group.
* Fleets without M1/M2 capitals still form one large group.
* === Step 5: Create group arrays. ===
* === Step 6: Distribute M1/M2 capitals evenly. ===
* === Step 7: Distribute remaining independent ships evenly. ===
* === Step 8: Create the new fleets. ===
* Safety check.
* A lone Xenon ship cannot form an invasion and falls back to defense.
* === Step 9: Release the lock or retry if needed. ===
